fields.description: Issue includes editorial and feature coverage of the Charles Haynes case (convicted of manslaughter in the killing of Policeman Frank Beckham) with discussion of bootlegging and prohibition-era justice; an extended critique of Florida Power & Light Company and associated power-trust publicity and rates; a letter explaining delay in a recall effort against city commissioners Sewell, Platt and Knight with plans for a Bayfront Park meeting; commentary on convention economics following the Shrine convention and anticipating the Elks convention; an editorial urging financial support and reforms for the University of Miami; local political advertising and campaign notes; late news bulletins; and a Nassau column on Coast Guard prohibition enforcement and tourism.
